counterfactual_missing_items: no intratumoral hemorrhage or cystic change
decisive_items: expansile, mildly enhancing soft-tissue mass in the anterosuperior nasal cavity
cystic mass occupying the left fronto-ethmoid region with destruction of the anterior skull base
mass at the level of the left middle turbinate extending into the left nasal roof and eroding the upper nasal septum
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the raw vignette spans, including the description of the mass as expansile and mildly enhancing, and the presence of a cystic mass with destruction of the anterior skull base. R3 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, but it is less comprehensive than R2.

rejected.why: R1 is rejected because it has limited supporting evidence and the presence of a cystic mass and retention of secretions can be explained by other conditions as well.
